name: @quickcart/desktop
description: QuickCart Windows desktop (.exe) application powered by Electron + Next.js standalone
author: QuickCart

scripts.dist:win: npm run generate:icons && npm run build:main && npm run prepare:standalone && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:portable: npm run generate:icons && npm run build:main && npm run prepare:standalone && electron-builder --win portable --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:win:zip: npm run generate:icons && npm run build:main && npm run prepare:standalone && electron-builder --win zip --config electron-builder.yml -c.win.signAndEditExecutable=false
